name: englishvidya
description: English Vidya — Static site powered by Eleventy. Hindi-medium students ke liye English learning platform.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('_site', {recursive:true, force:true});" && node scripts/run-audit.js
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:css && node -e "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'; require('child_process').execSync('npx eleventy', {stdio:'inherit'})"
